pilot.development_and_tuning: Budget and cases must be frozen separately; pilot runs are not reliability evidence.

required_decisions_before_freeze: method code revision and exact diff
nominal object, furniture and robot assets
nominal MPC horizon selected using validation only
common runtime pacing and command budget

case_generation.note: Initial proposals for development calibration, not measurements or established robot limits.
case_generation.static_geometry: Save instantiated obstacle placements and route, not only the random seed; maintain reachability without reference to controller success.
case_generation.size_prior: The same allowed geometry prior is supplied to all methods; this plan does not claim unknown-object size inference.
case_generation.strict_park_feasibility: Pre-screen the entire local mechanism path at fixed base for every case using method-independent geometry/IK; publish rejected candidate counts. House sequential strategy may move during mechanism operation.
case_generation.physics_material_and_mass: Record nominal mass, inertia, contact/friction and joint limits from the frozen assets. Physical friction is the main condition; fixed relative constraint is a diagnostic only.

fairness.translational_limit: same velocity-vector norm cap plus same wheel limits; not independent vx/vy caps only
fairness.tuning: same development data and predeclared tuning budget; allow method-specific internal costs; no formal-test retuning
fairness.wholebody_adapter: document the external QP adaptation to this robot and position interface; verify free-space command response; N=1 is an internal ablation, not the external baseline
fairness.runtime_pacing: same fixed target pacing for all methods within a comparison; prefer 1.0 if feasible in pilot; slower common pacing supports control effectiveness but not unverified real-time claims

success_thresholds_initial_proposal.storage: whole object geometry within bin interior and stable for 1 s
success_thresholds_initial_proposal.full_task: all required stages, terminal base/arm state, and no unpermitted contact
success_thresholds_initial_proposal.stopping: measure actual base and joint velocities continuously, report fault-to-stop and last-input-to-stop separately; a tail-done event or frozen physics is insufficient
success_thresholds_initial_proposal.timeouts: Set family-level simulation caps and infrastructure caps on validation data before test; all methods share the same caps.

statistical_unit: paired scenario seed; cluster repeated frames and ticks within the scenario
timing_analysis: report paired-both-success sample size and conditional times; all-attempt success and preregistered failure-penalized score separately
multiple_comparisons: predeclare primary comparator; adjust multiple primary contrasts (e.g. Holm)
confidence_intervals: paired/cluster bootstrap for continuous summaries; stratify layouts; binomial bounds only under their assumptions
not_run: This directory contains planning artifacts and generators only; no ROS or simulator launch is performed.
